Crafting and recipes

There is no workbench: every recipe is crafted from the pack. This guide explains the panel and lists every recipe with its exact amounts.

Voxelgame main dd29d91 · 5 min, then look things up · Everyone · feature ledger · all guides

How the Craft tab works

Open the inventory with E and choose Craft. Recipes are grouped into four sections: Timber, Fire & food, Materials and Tools & arms. Each ingredient shows as carried / required. Everything is crafted anywhere, with no workbench, fire or furnace. Craft tab (crafting panel)

Key or actionWhat it does
Up / Down arrows, mouse wheelSelect a recipe.
Left / Right arrows, or click a sectionChange section.
Enter or C, or click CraftCraft once.
Shift + Enter, Shift + C or Shift + clickCraft repeatedly until materials or space run out (at most 256 batches).
  • In survival the ingredients are spent and the result needs room in the pack. Failures read 'Missing materials for …' or 'Not enough free carry capacity'.
  • In creative the ingredients are free ('Creative: ingredients are free').
  • A crafted tool is equipped at once and a crafted boat is selected.
  • You cannot open the inventory while inside a vehicle.
Good to know. Counts are half-metre pieces. One full one-metre block is 8 pieces, so a recipe that needs 8 of a material needs one block of it.

Which ingredients can be mixed

A few ingredients accept a whole group of materials, and you can mix the members freely. Interchangeable ingredients

  • Boards: any species (Alder, Birch or Pine).
  • Natural stone: any of 26 natural stones.
  • Hardwood or deadwood: any hardwood log or deadwood.
  • Plant fiber or Wool.

Every other ingredient must be that exact material: Pale sand (not other sands), River clay (not ochre, umber, sienna, cracked or banded clay), Reeds (not Tall reeds), Limestone, Granite, Natural cobble, Moss, Chalk, Basalt, Red ironstone, Glass, Feather, Raw meat, Venison and Lumen crystal.

Good to know. Not usable as natural stone: Magma stone, Iron ore chunks, Bog iron, Amethyst, Salt, Sulfur crust, Mineral crust, Geyserite and any crafted masonry. Sandstone is the exception: it counts as natural stone, although you can also craft it from sand.

Quick craft with X

With the inventory closed, X crafts the first recipe you can currently afford, in list order, not the recipe you last selected. In creative it only shows a message. Quick craft (X)

Careful. The list starts with the four log-splitting recipes and then 'Burn a charcoal pile'. With boards but no logs, X turns four boards into two Charcoal.

Fire, glass and cooking

Fire work is crafting, not a placed furnace: burn 4 boards into 2 Charcoal, then spend Charcoal to cook meat, fire Pale sand into Glass, blow Glass into flasks, and fire clay, limestone and lacquer. Fill flasks by pressing T at water. Charcoal, cooking and glass (no furnace)

Tip. Besides the 'Fire glass' recipe, the Survey workshop landmark's one-time find gives 8 Glass.

All 40 recipes

Every recipe in this version, in the order the Craft tab shows them. Each makes the stated amount from the stated inputs in one craft.

RecipeMakesNeeds
Split alder boards4× Alder boards

Counts are half-metre pieces: one full 1 m log block (8 pieces) splits into 32 boards.

Split birch boards4× Birch boards
  • 1× Birch log

  • 1× Pine log
Split hardwood boards4× Alder boards
  • 1× Hardwood or deadwood (Oak, Fruit tree, Acacia, Willow, Mangrove, Jungle, Cherry, Giant old-growth, Palm, Mesquite, Fig or Cypress log, or Deadwood)

Always makes Alder boards whatever the species. Driftwood, Charred log, Mossy fallen wood, Bamboo, Cypress knees and Mangrove roots cannot be split.

Listed last in the Timber section. Crafting selects the boat ready to launch; it weighs 18 kg.

Recipes survival cannot finish yet

Red lantern, Alder rifle, Four rifle rounds, TNT charge and Two dynamite sticks each need Lumen crystal, which does not generate naturally in the world, so a survival player cannot gather enough. They work in creative, or in survival with crystals carried over from creative by pressing F4. Lumen-crystal recipes in survival

Planned, not in the game. A placeable furnace or campfire, smelting, metal tools and tool durability are planned and have no recipes in this version.

How this guide was checked

The recipe tables are generated from data/recipes.json, which was extracted from the game's recipe registry at Voxelgame 03c6519 (the other features are still from the audited commit dd29d91); tools/validate_guides.py can recheck all 40 names, sections and amounts against a source snapshot.

Voxelgame main dd29d91, committed 10 October 2026; guide written 11 October 2026. Source-checked, not play-tested. Amounts are carried pieces: 8 pieces make one full one-metre block. Recipes for furnaces, smelting and metal tools do not exist yet. Features covered, with their source evidence: Craft tab (crafting panel), Complete recipe list, Interchangeable ingredients, Quick craft (X), Charcoal, cooking and glass (no furnace), Lumen-crystal recipes in survival, Stone tools (single tier, no durability).
